reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the 76ers start about 6 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the 76ers.
Bottom line: the 76ers win 66 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.

analyst.text: Philadelphia are on the second night of a back-to-back, and neither Joel Embiid (plantar fascia) nor LeBron James has played both ends of one this season, so a thinned-out 76ers lineup is possible. Brooklyn have their own noise: Jordi Fernandez's rotation is being questioned after a heavy loss to Memphis, and Michael Porter Jr. is expected back after missing Saturday for personal reasons. If Philadelphia rest their stars, the news angle leans towards Brooklyn keeping it closer.
